symptom: `mxcli syntax expression` named no isNew, add*/subtract* or trimTo* function although `mxcli check` accepted and type-checked all of them
cause: the only expression topic was hand-written around specific pitfalls (regex, *Between, braces); the authoritative list of built-ins lived only in mdl/exprcheck funcTable
insight: When the checker already holds a measured table, render the docs from it (exprcheck.Functions()) instead of adding the reported names by hand: one change documented ~90 functions with the exact types E005 enforces. Leave out rows marked unverified — hour()/dayOfYear() etc. are CE0117 on a real build, and documenting them would send readers into a build failure.
